mission: Desh's sabotage mission — cutting to his operation against Veraine's crew-guarded amplification nodes. Former GAG operative vs. mundane opposition under extreme time pressure.
why_now: Two-stage defeat of Veraine: Stage 1 is physical/tactical. Desh removes the amplification that makes Veraine's ritual viable.
conflict: Desh against armed crew guards at critical nodes. He's outnumbered but outclasses them — former intelligence operative with combat training against salvagers and true believers. The challenge is time: he needs to disable three nodes before the resonance fails.
turning_point: Desh disables the third critical node. Veraine's amplification drops below threshold. She's strong alone — but not strong enough alone. The seal was the work of thirteen anchors. She was always depending on the array.
opening_hook: Desh at the first node. Two guards. The approach is textbook GAG — silent, efficient, nonlethal. He's not here to kill anyone. He's here to break three pieces of equipment.
closing_hook: The third node goes dark. Desh's comm: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing — do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
emotional_trajectory: Professional focus -> escalating physical danger -> triumph through competence

stakes.personal: Desh proving that non-Force-users are essential, not auxiliary
stakes.interpersonal: Desh and Ben's partnership — one handling the mystical, one handling the physical
stakes.external: Without the array, Veraine cannot breach the wound. Stage 1 of her defeat.

setting: Veranthos — amplification node sites, guarded positions, Desh operating solo
sensory_details: Desh in his element — silent movement, tactical assessment, controlled violence; node equipment sparking as he disables it; Veraine's crew — scared, outmatched, not villains; the comm connection to Ben — Desh's steady voice against the chaos
action_beats: Desh approaches the first node in textbook GAG silence — low, fast, nonlethal takedowns on the guards
Desh disables the first amplification node with three precise strikes to the control housing
Desh's comm crackles as the third node goes dark: 'Array's down. Do it now. Everything.'
promises_paid: Desh will matter to the climax (PP19)
notes: Desh's climax contribution. The non-Force-user saving Force-users by doing what no Force ability can — hands-on, physical, practical work. His GAG training turned to genuinely good purpose. Redemption of their shared history.
